title: fix(waterjet): add machine and nozzle kinds with validated cut data
body:
## What changed

Add the declared `waterjet` machine kind and `Waterjet` nozzle tool kind.
Require linear X/Y axes and allow optional Z.
Refuse spindle, live-tool, rotary, and milling-coolant keys by name.
Require zero nozzle RPM and positive finite kerf.
Store material/thickness recipes with cut feed, kerf, pierce time, abrasive delay, re-pierce time, and pierce method.
Check XY travel and feed limits, including arc extrema.
State which Z and spindle checks do not apply.
Preserve recipes through project files, tool libraries, and the tool editor.
Give the nozzle its own original icon.

The branch starts at upstream/main `cda3d5896` as requested.
The fork's main branch was not synced or changed.
The decision record is `docs/decisions/1881-waterjet-kinds.md`.
No dependencies or process files changed.
Effort: high.

## Cause

The parser did not recognize waterjet machines.
The tool and cutting-row models had no waterjet kind or material/thickness recipe data.
Existing machine checks assumed other machining families and their required axes.

## Tests

`waterjet_xy_without_z_parses_and_keeps_asymmetric_travel` failed at runtime on unchanged upstream/main `cda3d5896` because `waterjet` was an unknown machine kind.
All 27 new targeted tests pass with the patch.
All 74 guard mutations failed at runtime and passed after restoration.
Four replay groups also restored actual upstream source files, failed at runtime, and passed after the fix was restored.
No compile failure counted as a successful mutation check.
All temporary mutations were restored.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green, four steps, zero failures.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green.
- `cargo xtask icons --check`: green.

The existing allowed-kind message assertion now includes the intentionally added kind.
No test was skipped or weakened to pass the gate.

## Goldens moved

None.
`git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` is empty.

## Not exercised

No physical waterjet cutting was exercised.
This slice adds no concrete waterjet operation or built-in waterjet post.
Existing operation families remain refused on waterjet machines.
Undeclared user posts remain refused; a user post must explicitly declare waterjet support.
Before-and-after UI screenshots are linked below. No release-lane snapshot run was made.

## UI screenshots

These are renders of the shipping egui controls through the existing headless kittest renderer. The before captures use the tool page, cutting rows, and machine editor from the PR base `cda3d5896`. Two compile-only shims accommodate the added optional recipe field and machine enum variant; neither adds a visible control. The after captures use this PR plus the review fix that disables Apply for an invalid recipe. The test build identity is pinned by the harness.

All six PNGs live only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. No PR-branch image or snapshot golden changed.

| Surface | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tool type choices | ![Tool choices before: no waterjet nozzle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/2d4e8ca80b70aa0adb77e545c60f89a583dbaf8e/2001/tool-choice-before.png) | ![Tool choices after: waterjet nozzle added](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/2d4e8ca80b70aa0adb77e545c60f89a583dbaf8e/2001/tool-choice-after.png) |
| Machine kind choices | ![Machine choices before: no waterjet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/2d4e8ca80b70aa0adb77e545c60f89a583dbaf8e/2001/machine-choice-before.png) | ![Machine choices after: waterjet added](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/2d4e8ca80b70aa0adb77e545c60f89a583dbaf8e/2001/machine-choice-after.png) |

The old tool editor has material rows with spindle RPM and feed. The new nozzle editor shows kerf and material/thickness recipe controls with no spindle RPM. Zero thickness disables Apply; a stated positive thickness and valid recipe enable it.

## Overlaps

No stack is needed.

- #1738 touches the same file, different function; whichever merges second refreshes. It changes operation seeds and module exports. This patch changes Family and waterjet check dispatch.
- #1681 touches the same file, different function; whichever merges second refreshes. It changes stock-radius stream data. This patch changes waterjet post eligibility.
- #1209 touches the same file, different function; whichever merges second refreshes. It changes WCS controls and exports. This patch changes tool controls and exports.
- #1817 touches the same file, different function; whichever merges second refreshes. It changes pocket seeds. This patch changes Family.
- #1713 touches the same file, different function; whichever merges second refreshes. It changes finish3d seeds. This patch changes Family.
- #1753 touches the same file, different function; whichever merges second refreshes. It adds a machine-library entry. This patch changes waterjet post eligibility.
- #1798 touches the same file, different function; whichever merges second refreshes. It adds report controls and an icon declaration. This patch adds waterjet tool controls and a separate icon declaration.
- #1931 touches the same file, different function; whichever merges second refreshes. It changes WCS properties. This patch changes the tool editor.
- #1717 touches the same file, different function; whichever merges second refreshes. It changes WCS properties. This patch changes the tool editor.
- #1330 touches the same file, different function; whichever merges second refreshes. It changes State and move handling. This patch changes ToolUi.

Changelog: Add waterjet machine and nozzle kinds, validated material/thickness recipes, and XY machine checks with optional Z.

Fixes #1881
